issue: शारद शतमुख — the glossary reads शतमुख as Śeṣa; MW and Apte give śatamukha only as 'hundred-mouthed' (and an Asura), not as Śeṣa, who is usually the thousand-mouthed.
अछत सुहाग सदा सुखदाई — सदा सुखदाई may describe her wedded fortune or Gāyatrī.
our reading: She keeps her wedded fortune whole, ever bringing her joy.
alternatives: Her fortune stays whole; (Gāyatrī is) ever the giver of joy.

issue: चिन्तत — 'one who reflects' (the jijñāsu of Gītā 7.16, beside आरत and अर्थी) or 'the anxious' (Drik Panchang prints चिन्तित).
